The list as posted has 59 cards; the post says 'NB I left the skiff out, whoops', so one Skiff (the Light Jabba's Palace vehicle) is added for 60. 'Skiff' could also mean Racing Skiff.
The 'Cards That Almost Made it/Have been in it' section (Aim High, Lost In The Wilderness, Weapon Levitation, Control & Tunnel Vision, Ounee Ta) is not part of the deck and is left out.
